messages:
lena_partnerships: Heads up — Foundry asked for a co-sell POC for an embedded assistant inside their desktop app. They want a 2-week pilot starting next Mon. Need architecture sketch, cost split guidance, SSO/KMS answers, and a short test plan. Any immediate blockers?

mike_solutions: For arch we should do a hybrid: primary requests to our hosted API, with a Private connector fallback for on-prem inference if they enable it. Question: do they want model weights in their infra for offline mode?

lena_partnerships: They said offline fallback "maybe" — prefer hosted but need on-prem option for air-gapped campuses. We'll confirm.

jamal_infra: Hybrid is doable. We need their network details (egress IPs, ASN) for firewall rules and a plan for KMS. If they want BYOK we'll provision HSM tunnels — ETA 2-3 weeks. Also need to decide VPC peering vs site-to-site VPN.

sophia_sales: Commercial Q: partner expects trial credits split 50/50 for POC compute. Can we provide a quick cost calc to confirm? They also asked if pilot counts toward committed usage if they convert.

mike_solutions: Quick calc: assume peak 200k tokens/day, batching & quantized model, estimated infra token cost ~$0.06/1k tokens => ~ $12/day raw. Add instance + infra amortized => ~ $85/day. So ~ $600 for 2 weeks. If split 50/50 => $300 each. (I will refine with exact SKU).

mike_solutions: Recommended profile: 1x a4.large for hosted edge + 1x dedicated small pool for failover. Enable prefix cache to drop token cost.

clare_security: Security flags: they requested SOC2 bridge letter, and a filled vendor security questionnaire. I'll need the questionnaire back with answers. Also: telemetry export — we only send aggregated usage by default; no raw user content unless partner signs data-flow appendix. BYOK + HSM adds time.

jamal_infra: For certs: their app uses mTLS to call our callbacks. We need client certs and rotation policy. I'll draft a cert issuance checklist. Also need their infra lead to approve ip allowlist.

sophia_sales: On branding: they want the assistant to not surface "Redwood" in responses. Legal said ok for POC with the branding toggle. I'll note in SOW.

lena_partnerships: Good. Schedule: Thu 10am PT 30m tech sync with their infra lead. I'll send calendar invite.

devrel_bot: Reminder created: repo for POC samples -> git.internal/redwood/pocs/foundry-embedded-assistant. Demo tenant: redwood-demo-foundry-2026.

mike_solutions: Blocker: their desktop uses an internal proxy that rewrites headers. We need to check outbound header preservation for auth. Also we need to support client certs pinned to our gateway.

jamal_infra: Action items for infra: (1) cert issuance steps + rotation policy, (2) VPC peering vs VPN recommendation, (3) sample allowlist and port matrix. Also enable prefix caching on the route.

clare_security: POC defaults: data retention TTL = 7 days, logs obfuscated, telemetry only aggregated. I'll attach a minimal answers doc link in the follow up. HSM/BYOK timeline note: +2 weeks.

sophia_sales: I'll confirm partner contact and commercial ask. I'll also draft a one-page SOW showing responsibilities and cost split so they can sign fast.

mike_solutions: Test plan to include: load test at 300 rps for conversational endpoints, latency SLO p95 <= 150ms, dataflow check (no user content to analytics), and integration smoke tests for mTLS.

lena_partnerships: Perfect. Assignments: @clare_security -> sec questionnaire + minimal answers, @jamal_infra -> certs & network matrix, @mike_solutions -> refined cost + instance SKUs + test plan, @sophia_sales -> partner commercial + SOW. I'll consolidate notes after Thu call and post next steps.

mike_solutions: One more note: include an opt-in flag for white-labeling response footers during POC (toggle off Redwood branding).

lena_partnerships: Noted. Thanks all — will follow up with the invite and initial SOW draft later today.
